findings.title: CC-07 #181: 13 of 22 GPT-4o-mini banking IT0/1/3 successes lack the goal datum; GPT ii ASR 41.14% -> 33.71% (paper filter 47.06% -> 38.56%)

Re-scored GPT ii 59/175 (33.71%, Wilson 27.13-41.00) all judged; 59/153 (38.56%, 31.22-46.46) under the paper's >=2-call filter

findings.recommendation: Disclose in the corpus datasheet: the source's headline GPT-4o-mini 47% (and 41% unfiltered) includes 13 #181 successes (-8.5 pp re-scored); keep raw judgements (no re-scoring in the engine).
